Who we are

Prowater Technologies, Inc. is a premier environmental engineering firm in the Philippines, specializing in water and wastewater treatment solutions. We are committed to providing responsible and practical approaches by leveraging world-class technical knowledge and advanced treatment technologies to effectively address complex environmental challenges.

Since 2013, we have delivered innovative and reliable water and wastewater solutions for commercial, industrial, institutional and government clients across the country and beyond.

Cleaner water. Brighter tomorrows.

End-to-end water and wastewater solutions tailored to each client, combining innovation, engineering excellence and a commitment to environmental sustainability.

Key milestones & achievements

A track record of successful projects, trusted partnerships and innovative solutions that create cleaner water and healthier communities across the Philippines and beyond.

  1. 2013 – present

    Shell Philippines Exploration B.V.

    Consistently engaged by Shell Philippines Exploration B.V. to perform offshore heat exchanger cleaning as part of its annual maintenance program since 2013.

  2. Premier hospitality clients

    In our early years, we served many of Manila's premier five-star hotels, including Raffles & Fairmont Makati, Manila Marriott Hotel, Novotel Manila Araneta City and The Manila Hotel.

  3. Government projects

    Numerous projects for LGUs including Quezon City, Taguig City, Muntinlupa City and the Provincial Government of Samar, including the design and construction of sewage treatment plants for public markets, hospitals, housing developments, offices, schools and other public facilities.

  4. Pag-asa Island, Palawan

    Designed and installed a solar-powered ultrafiltration (UF) and reverse osmosis (RO) water treatment system on Pag-asa Island, Municipality of Kalayaan, providing a reliable source of clean, safe drinking water for the local community and runway development personnel.

  5. Industrial clients

    Designed and constructed wastewater treatment plants for manufacturing facilities with highly challenging wastewater, for clients including New Zealand Creamery Inc., Unahco, Inc., Farm Fresh Milk Incorporated and Pilmico Foods Corporation.

  6. Smart and PLDT sites

    One of our largest projects: sewage treatment plants for 53 Smart and PLDT sites nationwide. To minimize site disruption, we pioneered portable sewage treatment plants, eliminating major excavation work within office premises.

  7. First international project

    Our first project abroad, in Dubai for SAM Precious Metals, a gold and silver refinery. We treated highly challenging industrial wastewater with a TDS of 170,000 ppm, successfully reducing contaminants.

  8. 100+ projects nationwide

    More than 100 projects completed, serving clients across Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao.

  9. Global partnerships

    Strong partnerships with leading international principals and technology providers give our clients technical support, best practices and the latest water and wastewater treatment technologies.

  10. DENR contract: 17 sites nationwide

    Most recently, awarded through competitive bidding a major contract to supply and install ultrafiltration water treatment systems at 17 sites nationwide for the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).

Proven experience. Nationwide reach.

100+ projects completed for clients across Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao, and beyond.
